definitions.gloss: to suffer; to be in pain; to struggle; to be troubled
definitions.explanation: To experience physical or emotional pain, or to have difficulty with something.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}で{苦|くる}しんでいる。
{借金|しゃっきん}に{苦|くる}しむ。
{彼|かれ}は{罪悪|ざいあく}{感|かん}に{苦|くる}しんでいた。

notes:
CONJUGATION:
- {苦|くる}しむ (dictionary form)
- {苦|くる}しみます (polite)
- {苦|くる}しんで (te-form)
- {苦|くる}しんだ (past)

PATTERNS:
- ～で{苦|くる}しむ: to suffer from ~
- ～に{苦|くる}しむ: to struggle with ~

RELATED:
- {苦|くる}しい: painful, difficult (adjective)
- {苦|くる}しみ: suffering, pain (noun)
- {苦|く}しめる: to torment (transitive)
